BiblicalUsage: Mered is rebellion, and Joshua 22:22 puts it on the lips of the eastern tribes at their own altar: if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, save us not this day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the tribes knew the weight of the word they used, and they staked their lives on not being guilty of it.
